blocking_defects: MASTER truth is not wired into the production runtime: MASTER_TRUTH_ADDRESS/SIGNER/FETCHER/DEXES are module globals defaulting empty/None and are only populated by test fixtures. account_net_actual therefore cannot become executable MASTER truth in normal runtime from existing config/env.
account_net_actual still accepts the old arbitrary account_net_provider whenever MASTER_TRUTH_ADDRESS is unset. That is a non-MASTER fallback and contradicts G3 MASTER-only ACTUAL semantics.

Settlement verification is not wired into the real send lifecycle: maybe_auto_send_would_send records only last_real_send and does not attach exchange oid/start time to the in-flight reservation or invoke settle_from_master_evidence. The new settlement method is exercised directly only by tests.

In-flight reservations remain memory-only. Restart after ACK but before independent MASTER settlement evidence drops the blocker and can permit duplicate/overlapping authority, violating G3 restart/recovery semantics.

terminal_reject is a caller-supplied boolean. settle_from_master_evidence skips independent fill/position reads on that path and clears the reservation without exchange-derived proof of terminal rejection/no fill.

HIP-3 settlement fill truth is incomplete: master_userfills calls userFillsByTime without a dex parameter and does not enumerate per-DEX fills. Upstream Hyperliquid SDK issue #287/PR #310 document that HIP-3 fill history requires dex-scoped userFills/userFillsByTime queries.

Unrelated inventory preservation is not operationally established: UNATTRIBUTED_INVENTORY is a mutable in-memory global defaulting empty and set only by tests; no authoritative baseline/recovery derivation or persisted attribution exists, so production cannot prove same-coin unrelated inventory will be preserved.
reconcile_sleeve() is a standalone helper used by tests but is not wired as a production convergence blocker before order authorisation.

required_corrections: Initialise production MASTER truth from HL_LIVE_HL_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS and signing identity derived from configured private key/Account; identities must be valid and distinct; no arbitrary production account_net provider fallback.

Persist unresolved pre-send reservation in existing SERVICE_STATE_FILE before exchange.order authority, including intent, coin/dex if known, planner side, authorised size, reduce_only, started_ms and pre-send MASTER truth; attach oid/status durably after exchange response without clearing on ACK.
Reload unresolved reservations before any new order authority; crash-before-oid reconciles from start_ms+intent attributes and remains blocking if ambiguous; partial persists remaining.
Enumerate all perp DEX scopes and query MASTER userFillsByTime per scope with dex, including default and HIP-3/builder; fail closed on missing scope and deduplicate deterministically.

Terminal reject/no-fill clear requires exchange-derived terminal rejection/refusal plus independent post-attempt MASTER no-fill truth across all required DEX scopes; caller boolean alone is forbidden.

Maintain frozen UNATTRIBUTED_BASELINE and confirmed copy-owned actual in existing SERVICE_STATE_FILE; establish only at explicit no-send baseline/recovery boundary; snapshots/restarts verify but never silently rewrite it; external/manual divergence blocks.
Wire reconciliation gate before convergence/order authority using authoritative MASTER net = unattributed baseline + confirmed engine-owned actual +/- unresolved reserved exposure within tolerance.
Wire real sender result into reservation/settlement lifecycle; immediate and restart/subsequent-loop reconciliation may resolve only from independent MASTER evidence.
